name: Apify
free_plan_limits: $5 of usage a month, 5 runs at once; blocked when used up
usage_note: Plan price is prepaid usage; most scrapers charge per result, e.g. $2.30 per 1,000 Instagram results
best_for: Ready-made scrapers for almost any site
notes: Each scraper has its own price on top of or inside your plan. Pricing page did not list the Google Maps or Google Search scrapers' prices; maps/search flags are from the Actor Store, not the pricing page.

name: Firecrawl
free_plan_limits: 1,000 credits a month, 2 requests at once
usage_note: 1 credit per page scraped; search is 2 credits per 10 results
since_note: Y Combinator company page lists it as founded 2024; some third-party sources say late 2023.
best_for: Turning web pages into clean text for AI
notes: Hobby is 5,000 credits; credits do not roll over on Hobby. Core code is AGPL-3.0 and can be self-hosted. Standard is $99 for 100,000 credits.

name: Playwright
best_for: Developers who code their own browser scrapers
notes: A code library from Microsoft, not a hosted service. You supply the computer, proxies and code. Official page does not state the license; Wikipedia calls it open source.

name: SerpApi
usage_note: Developer is 5,000 searches a month; Starter is 1,000 for $25
since_note: Founded 2017 in Austin, Texas (CB Insights; SerpApi blog).
best_for: Google and Bing results as clean data
notes: Plans are fixed search bundles; going over needs a bigger plan. Pricing page did not mention Google Maps; maps and AI-output not stated there.

name: Tavily
usage_note: Pay as you go is $0.008 per credit
best_for: Giving AI agents live web search
notes: Project is $30 for 4,000 credits; the page has a slider so the price may change with the amount picked.

name: Outscraper
free_plan_limits: First 500 Google Maps businesses free, resets every 30 days
usage_note: $3 per 1,000 businesses (501 to 100,000), $1 per 1,000 after that
notes: No monthly plan: you prepay credits (they do not expire) or get invoiced. Monthly cost depends on how many records you pull. Prices shown are for the Google Maps scraper only.

name: RapidAPI
usage_note: Each API sets its own price
since_note: Founded 2015 in Tel Aviv by Iddo Gino (Calcalist); a few sources say 2014.
best_for: Finding many third-party APIs in one place
notes: Not stated: official pricing page returned no readable prices. It is a marketplace, so cost and features depend on the API you pick. Docs say invoices under $0.50 roll over.

name: Exa
free_plan_limits: $10 of credits, resets monthly (about 2,500 basic searches)
usage_note: $4 per 1,000 basic searches, $7 per 1,000 standard searches
since_note: Founded 2021 as Metaphor Systems, renamed Exa in 2024 (TechCrunch; Cerebral Valley interview).
notes: No monthly plan, only pay as you go. The only fixed plan is Enterprise at $12,000 a year, paid upfront.

name: Selenium
since_note: Started in 2004 at ThoughtWorks (Selenium About page; Wikipedia).
notes: A code library for driving browsers, mainly used for testing. Run by a nonprofit. You supply the computer and code. About page does not state the license or price.

name: Browse AI
since_note: Launched 2020 per a TechCrunch article (read via a secondhand summary).
notes: The pricing page is inconsistent: $19 a month is the yearly-billed price, while another section shows Personal at $48 a month. Personal has 2,000 credits a month.

name: Bright Data
free_plan_limits: 5,000 SERP requests a month, no card
since_note: Founded 2014 as Luminati Networks, renamed Bright Data in 2021 (Wikipedia).
notes: Prices above are for the search (SERP) API only; other products are priced separately and were not shown. Scale plan is $499 a month for 380,000 requests.
